comment: Two alternative versions on one sheet, each with perfboard, wiring diagram, underside and etch mask. Read the first (large) one, which uses two big box-film 100nF capacitors. The second, compact version adds 2x 1N4148, a 1N4001 and a 47uF electrolytic to the same 4.7K/2M/100nF parts; those are not counted here. One of the 4.7K resistors feeds the LED pad.
